actors.name: Fran
actors.private_context: Fran started the meal train for the Okafor family on the neighborhood app. She knows that eight slots were claimed the first evening, leaving six slots unfilled. She wants the remaining slots to be filled within four days.

actors.name: Neighbors on Alder Court
actors.private_context: The neighbors are part of a sixty-household neighborhood app. They are aware of the meal train sign-up for the Okafor family, who just came home with newborn twins. Some may have already signed up, and others may consider signing up.

shared_context: A meal train sign-up for the Okafor family was posted on the neighborhood app by Fran. The sign-up has fourteen slots total. Eight slots were claimed the first evening (by 2026-10-05T09:00:00-04:00). The remaining six slots are open. The app allows neighbors to view and sign up for slots. The cutoff for filling all slots is 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00.

starting_events.description: The meal train sign-up for the Okafor family has eight slots already claimed. The remaining six slots are visible to all neighbors on the app.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that all fourteen slots of the meal train were filled (i.e., signed up for) by 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
